title: What harvest-as-seed does to the economy and the progression curve
ask:
Daniel's words, verbatim:

"I recommend we change the game so it's not necessary to buy seeds for the starting
plants. Rather, the plants when harvested can be planted as seeds. They can also be used
as consumables (e.g. pea shooter). Only when the player acquires an excess can they be
sold. Excess will be defined by game phase. Early game, the player only has storage on
their person and so excess is not a large number.. 5 or 10 maybe. Later, they'll get a
grain silo and other storage options that increases excess (so they can properly arm and
stock their defensive structures).
